Description

Make traders category based

MAKE SURE THIS MOD IS LAST IN order.json

Quests are here!

If you find some bugs or you want to suggest a feature please tell me.

The mod is in WIP state so don’t expect too much, for now you can enjoy sorted items :^)

Should be compatible with all mods.

Big thanks to JustNU for finding a way to hide traders.

Configuration

In connfig.json you can add traders’ ids to exclude them. (Traders in this list will not be hidden and their assort will not be added to category traders)

In this example, Prapor and Therapist will be available and Fence will be hidden (Fence is not included in category traders you can just hide him or not)

Here you assign the quest from any trader to the specific category trader, just put the id of the questline you want to have for the trader and you are good to go

If you don’t know where to get your trader id you can get all of the traders’ ids from allTraders.json. (Run the server with my mod at least once)
